verdict: Windows Installer service (`msiserver`) is unavailable. No MSI-based install can run on this client until the service is restored.
fix: Check the service: `Get-Service msiserver`. If stopped, `Start-Service msiserver`. If it refuses to start, try `msiexec /unregister` then `msiexec /regserver` from an elevated prompt. If that fails, the WMI repository or Windows Installer core is damaged: verify with `winmgmt /verifyrepository`.
